spec_match.rationale: Serialises the exact RFC 8941 dictionary the explainer specifies and Chromium parses: report-to as a quoted sf-string, entry-types and include-user-timing as inner lists of quoted strings, capture-early-failures as ?1/?0 or a bare key, paired with a Reporting-Endpoints member whose key must match report-to. The vocabulary and type rules mirror declarative_performance_observer_parser.cc; the flag id (chrome://flags/#declarative-performance-observer, flag-metadata.json expiry M160), --enable-features name and OT name (DeclarativePerformanceObserver, runtime_enabled_features.json5 status experimental) were all verified in Chromium source.

interactive.rationale: Every control regenerates the header pair live with validation warnings (invalid sf-key endpoint names, out-of-vocabulary entry types, empty entry-types, mark-without-allowlist); the read-back button performs a real fetch of the page's own URL and prints the actual reporting-endpoints and performance-observer headers received (verified in headless: 200, reporting-endpoints default="/telemetry/demo/report" present, performance-observer honestly absent).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises composing the pair with vocabulary validation plus reading back this page's real headers, which is precisely what the two sections do.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles: invalid endpoint keys (warning explains the Reporting-Endpoints member would be dropped), unknown entry types (silently-dropped warning naming ParseEntryType), the bare-key implicit-true form, =?0 opt-out semantics, clipboard unavailability, and fetch failure. The support probe rows can each genuinely return false and the absent-header state is reported to telemetry as an honest separate assert, never a pass.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6594955352080384, the explainer syntax anchor, the Reporting-Endpoints header spec, and RFC 8941.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; fieldset/legend panels on bg-paper; the dark header pre uses text-black background with bg-ivory text (AA); buttons override both background and color; probe verdicts use accent-emerald/accent-rose.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Desktop verified at 1280 (screenshot read: three panels, generated pair, green validity line, real header readout). True-360px layout verified via the same-origin iframe measurement (scrollWidth 345 == clientWidth, no overflow; the long flag/feature names use word-break in the banner) and a 360-wide rendered screenshot; inputs and buttons are 44px min-height. No physical touch device was available.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls panel no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related controls in fieldsets with real labels, keep inputs full-width on narrow screens, and never let fixed-width controls force horizontal scrolling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls are native inputs/selects/checkboxes inside fieldset+legend groups laid out with an auto-fit minmax grid that collapses to one column at 360 px; the generated-header pre scrolls in its own container.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for asynchronous state changes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async results (copy confirmation, fetch results, validation) through polite live regions and keep focus visible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: copy-status, readback-status and the warnings list are aria-live=polite; every input/select has an explicit label; :focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements.

guidanceConsulted.query: reliable page lifecycle telemetry beacon visibilitychange pagehide
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Route telemetry through declared endpoints rather than ad-hoc unload beacons.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The endpoint-name/Reporting-Endpoints coupling and its validation encode this: the demo warns when report-to cannot resolve to a declared endpoint.

openQuestions.question: The builder validates but cannot round-trip its generated pair through a real navigation (this server cannot emit Performance-Observer). Once a header-sending test route exists (requires a manual server.ts task per CLAUDE.md rule 8), add a 'serve me with this header' link and read the activation result.

summary: Composes and validates the exact header pair against Chromium's parser vocabulary and proves the deployment's honest state by fetching this page's real response headers; all probes can fail and the absent header is reported as absence.
